title: The Palace Guide
hero_prompt: Wide panoramic copperplate etching in the manner of Piranesi's imaginary architecture, hand-drawn crosshatching and fine burin lines on warm aged paper. One grand open archway stands at the center, a threshold into a vast memory palace. Beyond the doorway, receding halls, stairways and colonnades gradually turn organic: stone columns become tree trunks, vaulted ceilings become branching canopies, and the corridors knot into a rhizome of roots and vines linking many small lit rooms like nodes in a web. A single pale path of light runs from the foreground step through the arch and into the living interior, inviting entry. Deep chiaroscuro, strong central focal point, one dominant image, atmospheric depth, classical printmaking texture, sepia and iron-gall ink tones, no figures, no text.
icon_prompt: Bold high-contrast woodcut emblem: a single rounded stone archway doorway, thick black silhouette, with a simple branching tree growing up through the open doorway, its roots spreading across the threshold step. Solid black carved forms on a warm cream ground, very few large shapes, no fine linework, centered symmetrical composition, strong clear silhouette readable at tiny sizes, printmaking texture, no text.
